mapper.sql: select v.id, v.title, v.subtitle, v.description, v.video_content, v.cover_image, v.duration, v.file_size, v.author, v.source_id, v.category_id, v.view_count, v.comment_count, v.like_count, v.share_count, v.sort_order, v.is_recommended, v.is_hot, v.status, v.published_at, v.last_edited_at, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.transcode_id, v.md5, v.shareid, v.orgfile, v.rpath, v.domain, v.path, v.suffix, v.resolution, v.bitrate, v.fps, v.width, v.height, v.transcode_status, v.thumbnails, v.output_formats, v.slug, v.meta_title, v.meta_description, v.meta_keywords, v.video_type, v.quality, v.is_featured, v.allow_comments, v.language, -- 优先显示关联表中的分类，其次是直接关联的分类 COALESCE( (select GROUP_CONCAT(c2.name ORDER BY c2.sort_order DESC SEPARATOR ', ') from video_category_tag_relations vctr2 inner join categories c2 on vctr2.category_id = c2.id and c2.status = 1 where vctr2.video_id = v.id and vctr2.relation_type = 1), c.name ) as category_name, (select count(*) from video_images vi where vi.video_id = v.id and vi.status = 1) as image_count, (select count(*) from video_urls vu where vu.video_id = v.id and vu.status = 1) as url_count from videos v left join categories c on v.category_id = c.id

select v.id, v.title, v.subtitle, v.description, v.video_content, v.cover_image, v.duration, v.file_size, v.author, v.source_id, v.category_id, v.view_count, v.comment_count, v.like_count, v.share_count, v.sort_order, v.is_recommended, v.is_hot, v.status, v.published_at, v.last_edited_at, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.transcode_id, v.md5, v.shareid, v.orgfile, v.rpath, v.domain, v.path, v.suffix, v.resolution, v.bitrate, v.fps, v.width, v.height, v.transcode_status, v.thumbnails, v.output_formats, v.slug, v.meta_title, v.meta_description, v.meta_keywords, v.video_type, v.quality, v.is_featured, v.allow_comments, v.language, -- 基于关系表获取分类名称 (select GROUP_CONCAT(c.name ORDER BY c.sort_order DESC SEPARATOR ', ') from video_category_tag_relations vctr inner join categories c on vctr.category_id = c.id and c.status = 1 where vctr.video_id = v.id and vctr.relation_type = 1) as category_name from videos v

and v.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%') and v.subtitle like concat('%', #{subtitle}, '%') and v.author like concat('%', #{author}, '%')
and (v.category_id = #{categoryId} or exists ( select 1 from video_category_tag_relations vctr where vctr.video_id = v.id and vctr.relation_type = 1 and vctr.category_id = #{categoryId} ))

and exists ( select 1 from video_category_tag_relations vctr where vctr.video_id = v.id and vctr.relation_type = 1 and vctr.category_id = #{categoryId} )

order by v.is_recommended desc, v.is_hot desc, v.sort_order desc, v.published_at desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}

and v.status = #{status} and v.is_recommended = #{isRecommended} and v.is_hot = #{isHot}

SELECT v.id, v.title FROM videos v
LEFT JOIN video_category_tag_relations vctr ON v.id = vctr.video_id AND vctr.relation_type = 1
WHERE v.status = 1
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM categories c_short WHERE c_short.id = v.category_id AND c_short.is_short = 1 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM video_category_tag_relations vctr_short JOIN categories c_short_rel ON c_short_rel.id = vctr_short.category_id WHERE vctr_short.video_id = v.id AND vctr_short.relation_type = 1 AND c_short_rel.is_short = 1 )
AND (v.category_id = #{categoryId} OR vctr.category_id = #{categoryId})
AND (v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR v.subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR v.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
AND ( (v.sort_order > (SELECT sort_order FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId})) OR ( v.sort_order = (SELECT sort_order FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) AND v.published_at > (SELECT published_at FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) ) OR ( v.sort_order = (SELECT sort_order FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) AND v.published_at = (SELECT published_at FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) AND v.created_at > (SELECT created_at FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) ) OR ( v.sort_order = (SELECT sort_order FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) AND v.published_at = (SELECT published_at FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) AND v.created_at = (SELECT created_at FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) AND v.id > #{currentVideoId} ) ) ORDER BY v.sort_order ASC, v.published_at ASC, v.created_at ASC, v.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT v.id, v.title FROM videos v
LEFT JOIN video_category_tag_relations vctr ON v.id = vctr.video_id AND vctr.relation_type = 1
WHERE v.status = 1
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM categories c_short WHERE c_short.id = v.category_id AND c_short.is_short = 1 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM video_category_tag_relations vctr_short JOIN categories c_short_rel ON c_short_rel.id = vctr_short.category_id WHERE vctr_short.video_id = v.id AND vctr_short.relation_type = 1 AND c_short_rel.is_short = 1 )
AND (v.category_id = #{categoryId} OR vctr.category_id = #{categoryId})
AND (v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR v.subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR v.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
AND ( (v.sort_order < (SELECT sort_order FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId})) OR ( v.sort_order = (SELECT sort_order FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) AND v.published_at < (SELECT published_at FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) ) OR ( v.sort_order = (SELECT sort_order FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) AND v.published_at = (SELECT published_at FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) AND v.created_at < (SELECT created_at FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) ) OR ( v.sort_order = (SELECT sort_order FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) AND v.published_at = (SELECT published_at FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) AND v.created_at = (SELECT created_at FROM videos WHERE id = #{currentVideoId}) AND v.id < #{currentVideoId} ) ) ORDER BY v.sort_order DESC, v.published_at DESC, v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 1

select v.id, v.title, v.description, v.cover_image, v.duration, v.published_at, v.updated_at from videos v where v.status = 1 and NOT exists ( select 1 from video_category_tag_relations vctr inner join categories c on vctr.category_id = c.id where vctr.video_id = v.id and vctr.relation_type = 1 and (c.is_short = 1 OR c.is_pagination = 1) ) order by v.published_at desc, v.created_at desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}

select count(1) from videos v where v.status = 1 and NOT exists ( select 1 from video_category_tag_relations vctr inner join categories c on vctr.category_id = c.id where vctr.video_id = v.id and vctr.relation_type = 1 and (c.is_short = 1 OR c.is_pagination = 1) )

SELECT DISTINCT t.id, t.name, t.color, t.usage_count, t.status, t.is_hot, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM tags t INNER JOIN video_category_tag_relations vctr ON t.id = vctr.tag_id AND vctr.relation_type = 2 INNER JOIN videos v ON vctr.video_id = v.id INNER JOIN video_category_tag_relations vctr2 ON v.id = vctr2.video_id AND vctr2.relation_type = 1 WHERE v.status = 1 AND t.status = 1 AND vctr2.category_id = #{categoryId} AND (v.first_video_url IS NOT NULL AND v.first_video_url != '') ORDER BY t.usage_count DESC, t.name ASC

SELECT DISTINCT v.author FROM videos v INNER JOIN video_category_tag_relations vctr ON v.id = vctr.video_id AND vctr.relation_type = 1 WHERE v.status = 1 AND vctr.category_id = #{categoryId} AND (v.first_video_url IS NOT NULL AND v.first_video_url != '') AND v.author IS NOT NULL AND v.author != '' ORDER BY v.author ASC

SELECT v.* FROM videos v WHERE v.status = 1 AND (v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY v.view_count DESC, v.created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageNum}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM videos v WHERE v.status = 1 AND (v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
SELECT v.* FROM videos v WHERE v.status = 1 ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}
